messages:
alex: kicking off Sirocco13B int8 onboarding. baseline perf looks OK but we're seeing memory fragmentation + intermittent latency spikes at tail. starting investigation — posting logs and configs here.

jin: saw same on my canary runs. 2x latency tail at 95p when concurrent=6. OOM traces on nodes with older glibc.

lina: quick question — what defaults did you use for max_new_tokens and batch? guessing defaults are still 256 / auto-batch

alex: correct. default max_new_tokens=256, batch_threshold auto, max_batch 8. my first thought: reduce max_new_tokens default to 128 and hard-cap batching to 4 on small VMs.

alex: attaching the failing snippet from the runtime log:
```
[2025-09-15T14:22:03Z] ERROR evict: failed to allocate kv cache slot: cannot reserve 12MB
[2025-09-15T14:22:03Z] WARN oom: process killed: OutOfMemory (frag over threshold)
[2025-09-15T14:22:03Z] LAT 95p=312ms 99p=640ms q=6
```

jin: that matches my profiling. fragmentation grows after repeated short chats (prefix reuse) — KV caches not compacting. maybe disable prefetch for this model or lower prefetch_window.

lina: idea: enable compact-alloc path we landed last sprint for int8 models and set kv_trim_interval=60s for canary. also set reserve_slots=2 per worker.

alex: proposed quick config to try on canary pool-sirocco-1:
```
model: sirocco-13b-int8
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 128
  max_batch: 4
  prefetch_enabled: false
  kv_trim_interval_sec: 60
  reserve_slots: 2
  compact_allocator: true
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: pool-sirocco-1 -> sirocco-13b-int8 @ nodegroup-canary-3 (id: cg-07f)

qa-bot: smoke eval started (20 prompts, mixed len). will report quality/regression numbers in ~10m.

jin: also run quick quant-quality check vs fp16 to ensure no unexpected regressions from compact allocator toggles. add prompt set "sirocco_smoke_v1" to eval.

lina: noted. I'll add the eval and a short eval script to the canary job.

alex: if smoke looks good and no OOMs after 30m, we'll roll to canary=20% then full. if tail latency still high, fallback plan is keep max_new_tokens=96 and enable fallback-to-fp16 on high-latency calls.

lina: logging note: enable extra KV metrics on the workers: kv_fragmentation_ratio and kv_free_chunks. helps correlate with tail spikes.

alex: thanks. I'll watch the canary, ping here with results. tagging @jin @lina for visibility. :thumbsup:
